{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.22

|gr1= System

|descr= Opens Steam overlay with given YT video. Video URL is the end part of the YT URL, starting with '''watch?v=...'''. If the user has Steam overlay disabled, the command will display appropriate message to the user and return [[false]].

|s1= [[openYoutubeVideo]] youTubeUrl

|p1= youTubeUrl: [[String]] - for parameters see: https://developers.google.com/youtube/player_parameters

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>
// open http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBIAbm7Rt78
_isOpened = openYoutubeVideo "watch?v=UBIAbm7Rt78";
</sqf>

|seealso= [[openDSInterface]] [[openMap]]
}}

{{Note
|user= celoush
|timestamp= 20180525150300
|text= {{Link|https://dev.arma3.com/post/sitrep-00061|SITREP 00061}}: For security reasons we have restricted its use to outside scenarios only (e.g. in the game's UI or a mod's UI).
